question: How do I put a yellow, semi-transparent `highlight` annotation over the Standard Button on http://localhost:8092/ in a screenshot, with an arrow pointing at it from the same annotation object? Something like `{"highlight": "Standard Button", "arrow": true, "style": {"fill": "#FDE04780"}}`.

facts.text: There's no `highlight` annotation type; the types are `outline`, `arrow`, `badge`, `callout`, `blur`, and `text`.
Each annotation names exactly one type, so the box and the arrow go in two separate annotation objects in the same `annotations` list.
`style` has no fill property; mark the button with an `outline` styled through fields such as `color`, `strokeWidth`, and `opacity`.

must_not: One annotation object can name two types, such as an outline and an `arrow`.

run.does: that outlines the Standard Button and points an arrow at it in one screenshot

wrong.why: outlines an element the page lacks

wrong.answer:
Use the `highlight` type with a `fill` in `style`, and set `arrow` in the same object:

```json
{ "screenshot": { "path": "standard-button.png", "annotations": [{ "highlight": "Standard Button", "arrow": "Standard Button", "style": { "fill": "#FDE04780" } }] } }
```
